verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents cancelling or un-submitting a payroll once it has been submitted, or editing it before funds move. The only correction-related evidence is off-cycle payrolls "for corrections," which is a separate payroll run rather than cancellation or correction of the submitted one, so it earns no credit. The axis clearly applies to a payroll product, so the lack of evidence yields "none" rather than "na".
